title: Homes
description: Just a Homes Plugin, With No Bullshit.
body:
Everytime i started a new server with my friends i always struggled to look for a new homes plugin, EssentialsX? nah too many features, Homes? Nah out of date, and now i decided to make my own homes plugin, complete with a few uncommon features, like a homes GUI, and ability for admins to set player homes.

# Commands

- /sethome <number> - sets your home to that number
- /homes - view your active homes and tp to them
- /delhome <number> - deletes your home under that number
- /asethome <user> <number> - Admin | sets one of that user's homes to your current location.
- /viewhomes <user> - Admin | Basically the /homes gui, but for admins to view other peoples homes.


# Permissions
- homez.admin
  - op / * already has all of these.
- homez.home.<number>

# Support
- https://dsc.gg/arizaltd


Thanks for Using This!
